sentences.text: Kumail Nanjiani -LRB- born February 21 , 1978 -RRB- is a Pakistani-American stand-up comedian , actor , writer , and podcast host .	Pakistani-American	Pakistani-American

Nanjiani is best known for being a main cast member on HBO 's Emmy Award-nominated series Silicon Valley , as well as for providing the voice of Prismo on the Emmy Award-winning animated series Adventure Time .	Emmy Award-nominated	Emmy Award	Silicon Valley	Silicon Valley (TV series)	Prismo	List of Adventure Time characters#Prismo	Adventure Time	Adventure Time
He starred on the TNT series Franklin & Bash and the Adult Swim series Newsreaders .	TNT	TNT (TV channel)	Franklin & Bash	Franklin & Bash	Adult Swim	Adult Swim	Newsreaders	Newsreaders
Nanjiani also co-hosted the Comedy Central show The Meltdown with Jonah and Kumail .	Comedy Central	Comedy Central	The Meltdown with Jonah and Kumail	The Meltdown with Jonah and Kumail
In addition to his television and film work , he hosts two podcasts : The Indoor Kids and The X-Files Files .	The X-Files	The X-Files

In 2017 , Nanjiani starred in the romantic comedy film The Big Sick , which he wrote with his wife Emily V. Gordon .	Emily V. Gordon	Emily V. Gordon	romantic comedy film	romantic comedy film	The Big Sick	The Big Sick
